title: NBI files complaint vs ex-Davao City information officer Jefry Tupas over Gracioso claim
summary: The case stemmed from the NBI’s investigation into the sworn statement of Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., who earlier alleged that Tupas received money intended for Vice President Sara Duterte.
